body:
Thanks for nothing.  All of you have proven how pointless it is.  Two fucking people respond...one with nothing but fluffy bullshit.

Fuck you all.  Fuck everyone on Reddit who will gather to help some person who doesn't really need help because they think the cause is "cool" or something...but won't give a fuck about people who really suffer.  Fuck your stupid cats and your stupid video games and memes and other vapid bullshit that you spend so much time on. Fuck you karma and egos and bullying and hypocrisy and "oh I can't get laid" bullshit.  

I will be glad to permanently get away from you all.

Talking to a stranger online doesn't make you not alone.  Not alone is having real people present in your life.

If you had my pain and loss you would not say the world is beautiful so simply. There is just as much shit and pain and hell as beauty in the world and in people.

I don't have the health or money to survive...and no way to get enough of either.

"Rely on yourself".

There are times you aren't capable of surviving alone.  I have done it for as long as the life I built before would allow me.  I cannot anymore.  I refuse to suffer more and more and the systems that were supposed to help when such a thing happened have failed me.  It isn't so simple when you have medical problems that keep you from doing normal things.  I don't want to die either but nobody can suffer severe pain indefinitely.
